name: What is the typical timeline for an outdated-room modernization project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for an outdated-room modernization project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for modernizing a room depends on the project's complexity. A cosmetic update might take a few weeks, while a comprehensive renovation involving layout changes, plumbing, and electrical work could extend to several months. We establish a clear project schedule during the planning phase, keeping you informed of progress and any potential adjustments.
acceptedAnswer.description: Timelines vary; cosmetic updates take weeks, comprehensive renovations can take months. We provide a clear schedule.
